name: immune-brain-pi-extension
description: Explicit extension entry manifest for the Immune-Brain Pi lifecycle extensions. Helper modules in this directory (pi-canary-invocations.ts, pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts, pi-canary-native-review.ts, pi-canary-review-bundle.ts, pi-canary-verification.ts, runtime-stub.ts) are library code, not extension factories; listing only the three factory files here prevents Pi's directory discovery from loading them as extensions.
